name: Ophthalmologist

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: New patient eye consult with retina checks
services.story: The main story: a $35 new patient eye consult with the retina checks. Nothing is taken. The desk checks Alex's plan, and Alex pays the share at the front desk.

services.name: New patient eye consult with retina checks
services.story: The same consult where the practice turns on its $20 missed-visit fee. A card is saved for it, never for a fee-free patient.

services.name: Laser treatment (one eye)
services.story: A laser treatment for one eye, $140: a $40 deposit when booked, and the $100 rest paid at the chair after the treatment.

services.name: Eye pressure check
services.story: An eye pressure check, paid in full when booked: $55. Nothing more is owed after.

services.name: Eye imaging, quoted from photos
services.story: An eye imaging scan quoted from Alex's photos at $90. A $20 deposit once the quote is OK'd, and the $70 rest at the scan.

services.name: Eye problem visit
services.story: A red, sore eye the same day. Only the $25 check is promised; any test or drops are priced first, with Alex's yes.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Tomas (ophthalmologist) and Gia (ophthalmic technician), who travel with a portable exam kit
B.customer: Alex M. (patient, lives at Riverside care home) · other patients

services.name: Eye check and follow-up at a care home
services.story: The main story: a $179 eye check and follow-up at Riverside care home. Nothing is taken. The practice bills Alex's plan its own way.

services.name: Eye check and follow-up at a care home
services.story: The same check, paid privately: nothing is taken when booking, and Rosie texts the bill when Tomas texts DONE.

services.name: Eye problem at a care home
services.story: An eye problem at the care home. Only the $89 eye check is promised; any test or drops are priced at the visit, with Alex's yes first.

services.name: Low-vision aids
services.story: Low-vision aids, quoted by Tomas after a first exam at $640. A $160 deposit once the quote is OK'd, and Rosie texts the bill for the $480 rest.

services_shape: visit types in an exam room, each with a set length; a first visit has a technician's tests, then the ophthalmologist's exam; a procedure is planned after the tests and booked as its own visit; every visit needs a free exam room
questions_before_times: for you, your child, or someone you help (a care home resident)
which visit: the practice's own visit types only (a new patient consult, a laser treatment, an injection, an imaging scan, or an eye problem visit), never a symptom typed into the AI
a vision or medical plan (its name only) or paying yourself
safety_stop: sudden vision loss, sudden flashes of light, or a shadow or curtain across the vision
a chemical splash in the eye, or something stuck in it
an eye hit hard or cut, or sudden bad eye pain with a headache or throwing up
first_steps: Health history, consent and the plan's papers
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
license: each ophthalmologist holds their own medical license from the state's medical board; an ophthalmic technician holds one only where the state licenses technicians
staff_skills: ophthalmologists: exams, laser treatments, injections, eye surgery referrals, low-vision aids and prescriptions; ophthalmic technicians: pre-tests, imaging, drop teaching and the work the state allows; only people cleared for mobile visits go to care homes and schools
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, the results, the medicines or the ophthalmologist's name (when the ophthalmologist comes to a care home, school or home, the name stays, for the door check); scans and results never go through Rosie
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
